item.title: Nancy Guthrie Abduction: Search Enters Week Three
item.description: 'Today' show Savannah Guthrie posts another video on Instagram pleading for her mother, Nancy Guthrie's return, saying 'It's never too late to do the right thing,' as the search for Nancy Guthrie enters week three. (2/16/26)

item.title: Tara Baker Murder Trial: Key Moments in Closing Arguments
item.description: Key moments in the closing arguments are presented in the case against Edrick Faust, who faces life in prison for the 2001 cold case murder of UGA law student Tara Louise Baker. (2/13/26)

item.title: Mother charged in death of 5-year-old found in trash bag by water
item.description: PENSACOLA, Fla. (Court TV) — A Florida woman is accused of killing her child, whose body was found wrapped in towels in a trash bag by a bay. Jalynda Smith, 36, is charged with aggravated manslaughter of a child in the death of Jakaiden Smith, her 5-year-old son with autism who was nonverbal. Investigators began... Read more »

item.title: Nancy Guthrie Abduction: TMZ Receives Fourth Email Demanding Money
item.description: According to reports, TMZ has received their fourth email, which contains the same Bitcoin account as the other three notes, demanding money for information on the Nancy Guthrie case. Guthrie was last seen on Jan. 31 and reported missing the next day. (2/16/26)

item.title: Trial underway for a Georgia high school shooting suspect’s father
item.description: WINDER, Ga. (AP) — A man whose teenage son is accused of killing two students and two teachers at a Georgia high school should be held responsible for providing the weapon despite warnings about alleged threats his son made, a prosecutor said Monday. item.title: ‘Gave My Son a Gun’ Murder Trial: Opening Statements
item.description: Opening statements are presented in Colin Gray's trial where the father of accused school shooter, Colt Gray, faces charges for his alleged role in the shooting that killed four people at Apalachee High School in Georgia. (2/16/26)

item.title: Teen pleads guilty in death of 5-year-old Prince McCree
item.description: MILWAUKEE — A Milwaukee teenager charged in the death of 5-year-old Prince McCree pleaded guilty to five felony charges in court on Monday. item.title: Apalachee High School Teacher: ‘I Could See The Bone’ in Student’s Wrist
item.description: Cassandra Ryan delivered emotional testimony describing seeing her students get shot and searching for missing students. Colin Gray is accused of giving his son, Colt Gray, the weapon used to carry out a mass shooting at the school. (2/16/26)

item.description: Apalachee High School teacher Katherine Greer testified as the jury saw surveillance video of a classroom and the 911 call from a student. Colin Gray is accused of giving his son, Colt Gray, the weapon used to carry out a mass shooting at the school. (2/16/26)
